parsed.rationale: The ticket says the app is 'broken again' and 'Nothing works anymore,' implying a continuing product defect, but it provides no specific behavior, affected feature, error messages, or impact details to confidently classify as bug/outage/performance/security/etc.

parsed.draft_response:
Hi—sorry about the repeated disruption. I understand this is urgent and you don’t have time to re-explain.

To get this fixed as quickly as possible, can you reply with just the following:
1) Which feature/workflow is failing (e.g., login, creating a record, exporting, API action, etc.)?
2) What exactly happens when you try (include any error message/code, if shown)?
3) When did it start (approx. time/date) and is it happening consistently?
4) Is this for your whole org/tenant or only certain users/accounts?
5) Your environment (Production vs Staging) and whether you recently changed anything (permissions, integrations, SSO, API keys).

If you have it, please attach a screenshot of the error or paste the log snippet/error code—otherwise, even the error text is enough.

Once I have these details, we’ll escalate to the engineering team to investigate immediately.
promised_actions: Request minimal information to identify the failing feature and error details
Escalate to the engineering team for investigation
safety_notes: Did not assume the specific cause or confirm an outage.
Did not promise a fix time, refund, or SLA.
Requested the minimum useful clarifications (failing feature, error details, timing, scope, environment).

What behavior occurs ('same thing as last time') and what exactly changed since the last incident.
Any error messages, logs, screenshots, or error codes.
When the issue started and whether it is continuous or intermittent.
Whether this affects all users or only certain users/accounts/tenants.
How frequently it happens and any steps to reproduce.

Severity indicators such as outage status, inability to perform key actions, or performance symptoms.
